task.title: Fix contact form validation UX and auto-populate frequency from tier
task.description: Four specific fixes to the contact form: (1) When saveContact() validation fails, instead of just showing ctErr div, also add style border-color:var(--red) to each missing required field's input/select element. Add a focusin listener to each required field that removes the red border when user clicks it. (2) Add email format validation in saveContact(): if(data.email&&!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(data.email)){show error on ctEmail: 'Enter a valid email address';return;} (3) Wire the Tier dropdown to auto-populate Frequency: document.getElementById('ctTier').addEventListener('change',function(){const freqEl=document.getElementById('ctFreq');if(!freqEl.value){const defaults={A:14,B:30,C:60};freqEl.value=defaults[this.value]||'';};}); (4) Add character counters below History and Notes textareas. After each textarea, add a small div showing character count. Wire input events: ctHist and ctNotes textareas get oninput handlers that update a counter div showing 'N / 500 characters' in 12px gray text. In saveContact(), truncate history and notes to 500 chars and show a warning toast if truncation occurs.

blocking_issues: No keyboard focus indicators visible on interactive elements (nav-item, buttons, inputs show outline:none without visible alternative)
Modal close buttons use × symbol without accessible label/aria-label for screen readers
Tables lack proper semantic structure - no <thead>/<tbody> separation affects screen reader navigation

No skip-to-main-content link for keyboard users to bypass sidebar navigation

No ARIA labels or roles: Interactive elements like '.contact-name-link' and '.msg-btn' buttons lack proper ARIA attributes for screen readers

No visible focus indicators on .nav-item, .sidebar-logout, and modal close buttons for keyboard navigation
